title: Gig worker money tip: set tax money aside first
label: Gig worker tip

hook.sub: Move this money before you spend it.

beats.note: Once net earnings reach $400 for the year.

items.t: Move a set % of every payout
Pay estimated tax during the year
items.s: Not one big bill in April.

cta.sub: We'll DM you the 1099 tax calculator.

captions.instagram:
Paid on a 1099? Nobody is taking tax out for you, so set it aside before it gets spent.

✔️ Self-employment tax is 15.3%, on top of regular income tax, once your net earnings reach $400 for the year.
✔️ Open a separate savings account and name it TAXES.
✔️ Move the same percentage of every payout into it, the day it lands.
✔️ Pay estimated tax during the year instead of one big bill in April.

Not sure what percentage to use? Our 1099 tax calculator works it out from your income and expenses.
